_meta.extractor_note: Notebook does not literally write m.Var() per tag; cell 6 instantiates GEKKO vars in a loop over the Excel `variables` sheet. The catalog below therefore enumerates the rows of that sheet plus any python-side override applied in the notebook.

stage1.purpose: Base reconciliation with WIDE physical bounds (lb_phys/ub_phys). Continuous + integer vars all relaxed at their excel lower_bound_value/upper_bound_value (with FIX-5b overrides). Goal: find a feasible plant mass/energy state matching PI snapshot.
stage1.bounds_used: lb_phys / ub_phys (after Production-Grade widening to 5000 ceiling and DMW>=220, BFW_Imbalance +/-20).

stage2.purpose: Apply tight What-If scenario bounds to CONTINUOUS variables only (lb_scen/ub_scen); integers remain at widened physical bounds. Solves continuous load-shift problem.
stage2.bounds_used: lb_scen / ub_scen (from lower_bound_expression/upper_bound_expression columns, dynamically evaluated against PI snapshot via evaluate_dynamic_bound()). VHP_Steam_Pressure window (e.g. [95,115]) lives in those expression columns of the Excel `variables` sheet -- NOT hardcoded in notebook.
stage2.revert_on_fail: If Stage 2 fails, reverts continuous bounds to physical before Stage 3.

stage3.purpose: Final MINLP. Continuous vars reverted to WIDE physical bounds, integer vars enforced at their physical integer bounds. Branch-and-bound on *_Status and *_Running counters.
stage3.recovery: On non-zero status, rounds integer DV current values, freezes them, switches to IPOPT for NLP recovery (cell 6 lines ~436+).

post.purpose: Cell 8 collects gekko_vars values; cell 9 writes Output_Comparison xlsx with FIX-4c proportional cost-display correction; cell 11 runs post-optimizer pipeline (SEU / ODS / PEEO / cause-effect sheets).

feature_file_loading_logic.code_summary: xl = pd.ExcelFile(FEATURE_FILE); for sheet in [...]: cfg[sheet] = xl.parse(sheet).dropna(how='all'). Plus master_pi_data row selection via PI_ROW_SELECTION ('best' = row with most non-null cells).
feature_file_loading_logic.tag_lookup_pattern: Each sheet has a tag_name (or parameter/expression) column iterated as cfg[sheet].iterrows(). No JOIN -- tags are matched by name string. PI values come from master_pi_data column headers matching tag_name.
feature_file_loading_logic.alias_handling: PI_ALIAS dict in build_working_ctx_from_row aliases AC_*_Flow_To_Header_raw <- Air_compressor_*_Discharge_flow_raw. LHV_Raw is broadcast to LHV_Raw_2..5 if missing.

sheet_to_model_object_mapping.variables: Each row -> m.Var() in cell 6 (skipped if name in IMBALANCE_PARAMS, which become m.Param). Bounds come from lower_bound_value/upper_bound_value (physical) and lower_bound_expression/upper_bound_expression (scenario, dynamically evaluated).
sheet_to_model_object_mapping.derived_equations: Each row -> m.Intermediate(eval(formula_expression)) -- OR m.Equation(var == intermediate) if the tag is also a decision variable.
sheet_to_model_object_mapping.constraints: Each row's expression column is split on ==/>=/<=/>/< operators and passed to m.Equation().
sheet_to_model_object_mapping.objective: First row drives m.Minimize()/m.Maximize(); the actual cost formula is looked up from the inferred sheet by tag_name.
sheet_to_model_object_mapping.model_parameter: Scalar configuration loaded into model_params dict (used for nlp_maximum_iterations, etc.) and merged into working_ctx for formula evaluation.
sheet_to_model_object_mapping.master_pi_data: PI snapshot (one row) -- provides initial values and frozen Param values for IMBALANCE_PARAMS.
sheet_to_model_object_mapping.inferred: Display-only formulas (Fuel_Bill, Power_Bill, Energy_Bill...). Evaluated in post-processing only.
sheet_to_model_object_mapping.tag: Tag library -- provides data_type (units) and tag_type ('pi' vs other) used to build the *_actual namespace.
